catalog_metric_definitions.raw_catalog_record: One source row in artifacts/aips-landing/data/products.json. This is the metric used by commercial.catalog_snapshot.record_count.
catalog_metric_definitions.public_projection_record: One source row after the governed public projection neutralizes blocked legacy and unverified fields. In approved-commerce mode the projection preserves source-row cardinality.
catalog_metric_definitions.public_plan_record: One eligible projected row counted by generate-homepage-v2-view.mjs when it is not a request-price-only row with no public price.
catalog_metric_definitions.active_tool_family: One unique eligible product slug after retired-platform filtering. Multiple plan rows can belong to the same tool family.
catalog_metric_definitions.rule: Do not compare raw catalog records, public plan records and active tool families as if they were the same metric. Generated build outputs are authoritative for current public-plan and family counts.
